answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The mesa holds work receipts rather than names, so the quartz of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the nebula of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
